answer: Every epoch the network quietly plants decoy rewards — a hidden pulse of fake-but-plausible profitable tasks aimed at low-history identities. Honest newcomers react diversely: some ignore them, some try and fail, each on their own rhythm. A sybil operator cannot leave free money on the table, so ten thousand sock-puppets lunge at the bait in one synchronized spiral of identical grabs. The lunge is the tell: the network retroactively flags the correlated cluster and voids its gains. Like one marble hidden in dough, the thing fake identities all chase is the thing that exposes them.
